units.source_text: 虽然隔帘传语，本人声音隐约可闻。

en.t: Although the message was passed through the curtain, her own voice could be faintly heard.

units.source_text: 源氏大将努力忍耐，但终于不能自制，簌簌地掉下泪来。

en.t: General Genji tried hard to endure it, but in the end he could not control himself, and tears fell quietly one after another.

units.source_text: 深恐这儿女柔情被这些六根清净的尼姑看见了，难以为情，略谈数语即便告辞。

en.t: Deeply afraid that these pure-minded nuns would see his tender feelings of love, he felt embarrassed, exchanged only a few words, and then took his leave.
